text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. The main goal is to make software easier to understand and maintain. By reorganizing and cleaning up the code, developers can improve readability, which helps both current team members and future ones. Refactoring also reduces technical debt, the extra work that builds up when code is written quickly without proper design. Although refactoring takes time, it prevents many problems later. Good developers refactor regularly, treating it as a normal part of their work rather than a special project.
